The first Parley for Android build, submitted to Google Play.

- **Record a meeting on the phone** and get a transcript, at the feature level of iOS 1.1, plus importing existing audio.
- **Recording survives leaving the app.** The microphone is held by a foreground service, so switching apps no longer ends the meeting, and one tap starts exactly one recording.
- **Delete your account in the app**, or from the web without installing anything, as Play requires.
- Store listing, screenshots, data safety answers and the foreground-service declaration for the Play submission.

This build was uploaded to Play by hand; later releases go out from the tag.
